title: Relationship Consistency Spec
description: Intra- and inter-record relationship consistency. Specification only.

rules.statement: Every relationship type MUST be in the ontology edge type registry.
FOUNDATIONAL_FOR and DEPENDS_ON subgraphs MUST be acyclic.
RELATED_TO SHOULD NOT be used where FOUNDATIONAL_FOR or DEPENDS_ON is required for definition correctness.
Self-relationships (source=target) are forbidden except explicitly documented reflective cases (default: forbid).
CONFLICTS_WITH MUST be paired with conflict notes or governance conflict registry entry when assertions disagree.
Relationship endpoints SHOULD agree with dependency_manifest level_id when both are declared.
